verdict.rationale: Retention and cohort analysis is a fair question for a web analytics product, but the evidence pack documents no retention report or behavioral cohort feature. The nearest features are funnels, filters/segments and period comparisons, which are adjacent and do not measure returning-user retention. A community note that uniques are hashed with a daily salt suggests visitors cannot be followed across days.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can measure retention over time and slice it by behavioral cohorts
